messages.author: 60024c93acb5156f
messages.subject: methylKit unite function error
parts:
Hello,

 

Thanks so much for providing the methylKit package, I’ve just begun using it and it’s great!  

 

I’ve run into trouble when using the unite function. The problem is similar to the error in this post on the discussion forum: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/methylkit_discussion/HkrsXJAhkYA

 

The error is:

 

Error in value[[3L]](cond) : 

  internal: samtools invoked 'exit(1)'; see warnings() and restart R

  file: /camp/lab/turnerj/working/Bryony/rrbs/test/methylKit_debug/methylDB 2018-04-24 NGO/test_fails_filtered_destrand.txt.bgz

In addition: Warning message:

In doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler) :

  [ti_index_core] the file out of order at line 2

 

 

When I look into the ‘destrand’ file at the specified line, I see that the genomic coordinates columns for that row are expressed as scientific e notation (e.g. “1.38e+08”), but in fact the coordinates are still in the correct sorted order. The preceding ‘filtered’ file, and the original ‘CpG’ file, do not display this column as scientific notation.

 

I’m attaching a short reproducible example, hopefully it will be helpful.

It contains two CpG.txt files, one which throws the error, and one which doesn’t, a text file containing the commands I ran in an R interactive session, the session info, and the files generated by this session.

 

Thanks and best wishes,

Bryony

messages.author: cf9d845519f0d673
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: methylKit unite function error
parts:
Hello,

I am wondering if anyone has resolved this issue.

I have the following error upon using unite() on a methylRawDB with destrand=TRUE.

I am using methylKit v1.6.1

# Loading in the methylRawDB files.
> file.list=list("methylDB/B0_R1_normed.txt.bgz",
+                 "methylDB/B1_R1_normed.txt.bgz",
+                 "methylDB/B2_R1_normed.txt.bgz",
+                 "methylDB/SN_R1_normed.txt.bgz")
>
> filt.norm.myobjDB=methRead(file.list,
+        sample.id = list("B0_R1","B1_R1","B2_R1","SN_R1"),
+        assembly = "hg38.v23",
+        treatment = c(0,1,2,3),
+        dbtype = "tabix"
+        ,dbdir = "methylDB"
+ )
> methDB=unite(filt.norm.myobjDB,
+              destrand=TRUE
+              )
compressing the file with bgzip...
making tabix index...

Error in value[[3L]](cond) :
  internal: samtools invoked 'exit(1)'; see warnings() and restart R

file: /share/samdata/kwillia4/FSHD/KW046_to_KW049_MeBcellline/methylKit/methylDB/B0_R1_normed_destrand.txt.bgz
Calls: unite ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>

In addition: Warning message:
In doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler) :

[ti_index_core] the file out of order at line 967275
Execution halted

At the line mentioned, 967275, the chr start and end are in scientific notation. In the preceeding file this was not a problem because the location was 600001 on the - strand, but using destrand=TRUE forces the site to the other strand and therefore changes the location to 600000 (6e+5 in the merged file).

The *.bgz file outputs fine, but the error occurs when making the tabix index.

This runs fine when setting destrand=FALSE. It also runs fine when save.db=FALSE. Worth noting, the resulting methylBase object when using save.db=FALSE does not contain the site that causes the problem. The problem only arises when trying to output and index the merged sites separately for each sample.

For now I will workaround and save the methylBase object separately, but I would like to know if anyone has fixed this.

Thank you.

parts:
I haven't seen such error and I can't see it in either closed or open issues. It looks like scientific notation is only in `bedgraph` function.(https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/blob/f9bedc75e84ac50633e6fa8416372593c53c3351/R/methylDBFunctions.R#L2316).When destrand=TRUE, `applyTbxByChunk` is ran with `return.type = "tabix"`,
so I guess if we add few lines of code to remove scientific notation in this if clause then it should be fine https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/blob/0d007f20b203cc567e90bc40227534007c95034b/R/tabix.functions.R#L393. In general, I think, whenever `write.table` is used, it can cause the same issues.
I can open an issue for it.

Kasia

It looks like scientific notation is only in `bedgraph` function.(https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/blob/f9bedc75e84ac50633e6fa8416372593c53c3351/R/methylDBFunctions.R#L2316).When destrand=TRUE, `applyTbxByChunk` is ran with `return.type = "tabix"`,
so I guess if we add few lines of code to remove scientific notation in this if clause then it should be fine https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/blob/0d007f20b203cc567e90bc40227534007c95034b/R/tabix.functions.R#L393. In general, I think, whenever `write.table` is used, it can cause the same issues.
I can open an issue for it.

Kasia

On Monday, August 13, 2018 at 3:47:22 PM UTC+2, Altuna Akalin wrote:
we noticed this bug already, I'm not sure if that is fixed yet. Alex/Kasia, did you fix this yet or is this listed as issues in github ?
On Wed, Aug 8, 2018 at 11:01 PM <kwil...@uci.edu> wrote:

Hello,

I am wondering if anyone has resolved this issue.

I have the following error upon using unite() on a methylRawDB with destrand=TRUE.

I am using methylKit v1.6.1

# Loading in the methylRawDB files.
> file.list=list("methylDB/B0_R1_normed.txt.bgz",
+                 "methylDB/B1_R1_normed.txt.bgz",
+                 "methylDB/B2_R1_normed.txt.bgz",
+                 "methylDB/SN_R1_normed.txt.bgz")
>
> filt.norm.myobjDB=methRead(file.list,
+        sample.id = list("B0_R1","B1_R1","B2_R1","SN_R1"),
+        assembly = "hg38.v23",
+        treatment = c(0,1,2,3),
+        dbtype = "tabix"
+        ,dbdir = "methylDB"
+ )
> methDB=unite(filt.norm.myobjDB,
+              destrand=TRUE
+              )
compressing the file with bgzip...
making tabix index...
Error in value[[3L]](cond) :
  internal: samtools invoked 'exit(1)'; see warnings() and restart R
  file: /share/samdata/kwillia4/FSHD/KW046_to_KW049_MeBcellline/methylKit/methylDB/B0_R1_normed_destrand.txt.bgz
Calls: unite ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>
In addition: Warning message:
In doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler) :
  [ti_index_core] the file out of order at line 967275
Execution halted

At the line mentioned, 967275, the chr start and end are in scientific notation. In the preceeding file this was not a problem because the location was 600001 on the - strand, but using destrand=TRUE forces the site to the other strand and therefore changes the location to 600000 (6e+5 in the merged file).

The *.bgz file outputs fine, but the error occurs when making the tabix index.

This runs fine when setting destrand=FALSE. It also runs fine when save.db=FALSE. Worth noting, the resulting methylBase object when using save.db=FALSE does not contain the site that causes the problem. The problem only arises when trying to output and index the merged sites separately for each sample.

For now I will workaround and save the methylBase object separately, but I would like to know if anyone has fixed this.

Thank you.
